body.title: PolicyReader
body.summary: Implement the synchronous, network-free reader in the HLD envelope: sighting checked first and taking precedence over every solo shortcut; branch from the sighting, else the remote HEAD, else unknown (remote is origin, else the sole remote, a sighting's recorded remote stays authoritative); read the policy from the tracking ref or the recorded commit; refuse with the team refresh --branch instruction only when a fetched tracking ref (symbolic HEAD skipped) carries the policy file while the branch is unknown; none when no sighting and no evidence; create-only sighting write on first observation; fill the derived source block including the anchor.
acceptanceChecks: The policy is read from the default branch tracking ref and working-tree or feature-branch edits have no effect.
Non-git, no-commit and no-remote directories without a sighting read as none with no write.
A known team repo whose remote was removed is refused or read from the recorded commit, never none.
An unknown default branch with a policy on a fetched ref is refused with the --branch instruction and no policy is applied; with no policy on any fetched ref it reads as none.
A never-fetched repo with no sighting reads as none.
The remote is origin when present, else the sole remote; several remotes without origin are not guessed (none without a sighting); a sighting's recorded remote stays authoritative.
The first observation creates the sighting create-only and a failed write never changes the result.
